runs.label: suite-run sh failure 2: regression-git-commit-mine.sh
runs.command: sh tools/regression-git-commit-mine.sh (inside the suite; MANAGENT_TASK_ID=T392 was exported for the run)
runs.output:
1. null control: PASS
  2. seeded control: PASS (refused, named src/claimlint.zig, no commit created; both staged sets intact)
  3. explicit arm: FAIL: RC=2, commit contains: docs/amendment.md / git-commit-mine: REFUSED - cannot resolve task T392 in the kanban
  (then controls 4-9 cascade-fail on 'REFUSED - index contains staged paths outside your scope')
  === regression-git-commit-mine: FAILURES ===
runs.clean_env_rerun: unset MANAGENT_TASK_ID && sh tools/regression-git-commit-mine.sh => all 9 controls PASS (commit c01cbea contains exactly docs/amendment4.md via kanban scope)
runs.interpretation: control 3's --explicit arm runs in a sandbox temp repo with no kanban store; the wrapper inherited MANAGENT_TASK_ID=T392 from this session's export and refused 'cannot resolve task T392'; the script greps lowercase 'refused' against uppercase 'REFUSED' so the refusal branch did not match, marking FAIL; the leftover staged docs/amendment2.md then poisoned controls 4-9. Not a HEAD failure; an artefact of my own environment.
